description:
Responsibilities: 
 Work in a structured environment to develop products using standard software engineering practices
 Develop software to support portfolio accounting of various products in the investment business
 Work with end-users to define requirements and deliver solutions
 Document products for end-user consumption and maintenance efficiency
 Guide and mentor other developers in project work
 QA the work of other team members and complete test cycles to ensure production readiness
 Analyze requirements to design highly usable and efficient solutions
 
 Qualifications: 
 2- 5 years experience in Simcorp Dimension and it's integration tools: Data Extractor, Filter Tool Box, Communication Server and Portfolio Calcuations
 2-5 years experience in Oracle 11.5 - designing, organizing, and consuming
 Experience in real time messaging (e.g., IBM MQ)
 Experience in XML and XLST 
 Professional development experience with significant projects
 Capable of working independently with demonstrated attention to detail
 Hard working and self motivated, requiring minimum supervision
 Excellent analytical and communication skills
 History of projects requiring application and system integration
 
 
 Ideal Candidate Would Have: 
 Finance background with an understanding of investment products and accounting
 Experience in C# /.NET
 Experience in Crystal Reports, Business Objects, or other reporting tools
 Experience in ETL and EAI tools
 MS Windows skills & Unix
 
 Business Experience & Education :
 -- BS, MS in Computer Science or similar discipline
 -- Experience in portfolio accounting, reconciliation and client reporting
